column6: The back-translation shifts the emphasis from 'fellowship' to 'brotherhood,' which may imply a more exclusive or familial connection rather than a broader community aspect. column7: To really work and function together you need to fellowship! You need to know others, love others and ideally like others! Build strong relationships and friendships and repair them when they become stressed or injured. When a joint gets injured or inflamed, you need to work to rest and or reset it; so that the joint that’s dislodged doesn’t become broken! A broken and unhealing limb will eventually be separated, and you cannot be part of the body, alone.
column8: To truly fit together and function you need brotherhood! You must know others, love others, and get the best from others! Build strong relationships and friendships, and repair them when they become strained or injured. A broken member that does not heal is eventually amputated, and you cannot be a part of the body by yourself.
